content.title: Content
content.description: Tiptap document supporting text, lists, images, callouts, details/detailsSummary/detailsContent toggles, table/tableRow/tableCell/tableHeader and pageLink blocks. Layout blocks support columns with 2-5 column children and optional widths (one positive numeric weight up to 100 per column), tabs with 1-12 tabPanel children (UUID id, title up to 80 chars), imageGrid atoms (count 2, 3 or 4 and matching images containing null or url/alt objects), a generated tableOfContents atom, and viewBlock atoms with view, source, title, query, filter, sort (manual, title or date), group, collectionId, metric and optional columns settings. Columns are keyed by stable status IDs To do, In progress, Done or column:UUID; optional columnOrder retains their order. View preferences hiddenColumns and hideAggregation hide columns or item counts without changing tasks. Optional cardSize (small/medium/large), cardPreview (none/cover/content or a Files property UUID) and boolean cardImageFit configure board card sizing and previews. Optional cardProperties is a unique array of up to 36 built-in keys (status, date, value, cover, description) or property UUIDs controlling board card fields; null preserves Image/Date defaults and an empty array shows only names. Personal lists can own an atomic board definition and task assignment. Column definitions contain a name up to 60 characters and a gray/brown/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple/pink/red color. Toggle detailsSummary headingLevel accepts null or 1, 2, 3. Callout icon attrs use emoji: or icon: symbols, or null. Page links use a UUID pageId and a title. Block attrs textColor/backgroundColor accept null, gray, brown, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink or red.
